description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeSupervisorAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various functionalities such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employee supervisor relationships, along with validation rules. The tests utilize mocking for dependencies and verify the API's behavior in different scenarios.
